title: Optimization experiment bundle v1 (research prototype)
description: Versioned allowlisted JSON/CSV/GeoJSON data and scientific formula selections. Historical lake GeoJSON allowed only by exact pinned SHA and water one-hop reference ID; arbitrary external real data is forbidden.

path.description: Relative local .json, .geojson, or .csv path inside the bundle directory; traversal, absolute and symlink paths rejected by loader

parameters.description: Typed, adapter-validated overrides. Unknown parameters are errors, not quietly ignored.

classification.description: RESEARCH_REFERENCE is only permitted for the exact committed lake GeoJSON SHA, never arbitrary imported real-world data.
